caseNameFull: Kostecka v. United States and Live Stock National Bank, Administrator v. United States
attorneys: Mr. Warren E. Miller for petitioner in No. 817. Mr. Stephen A. Cross for petitioner in No. 818. Solicitor General Fahy and Messrs. Julius C. Martin, Wilbur C. Pickett, Keith L. Seegmiller, and W. Marvin Smith for the United States.

opinions.text: Petitions for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit, and motions for leave to proceed further in forma pauperis, denied.
